Compare a recomputed region map against a published one

Source: R/rgnmap.R
rgnmapcmp.Rd

Matches two region maps on the unit and compares the named columns cell by cell, reporting for each column how many cells disagree and the first disagreement. Use it to confirm that a region map rebuilt from a boundary file reproduces the one that was published.

Usage

rgnmapcmp(pub, obs, unit, cols = NULL)

Arguments

pub, obs

The published and the recomputed map (data frames).

unit

The name of the unit column, in both.

cols

The columns to compare; NULL compares every column the two share apart from unit.

Value

A data frame of class rgnmapcmp: a first row "rows" for units on one side only, then one row per column, with column, cells, mismatched and first (the first disagreement written out, "" when none). Zero mismatched throughout is agreement.

Details

Units are matched as text with spaces trimmed; when a unit repeats, its first row is used. Numeric columns are compared with all.equal() at its default tolerance (relative \(1.5 \times 10^{-8}\)), so a coordinate that survived a round trip through text is not reported as a change; everything else is compared as text after trimming. Two missing values agree; a missing value against a present one does not.

What this establishes is that the recomputation reproduced the published assignment, not that the assignment is right: the same method on the same boundary file reproduces a definitional error perfectly. That is what rgnmapalt() is for.

See also

rgnmapalt(), rgnmapintg().

Examples

pub <- data.frame(inst = c("North Jail", "South Jail"),
                  cd = c("3557", "3520"))
obs <- pub
obs$cd[2] <- "3521"
rgnmapcmp(pub, obs, "inst")
#> rgnmapcmp: the maps disagree 
#>  column cells mismatched                                       first
#>    rows     2          0                                            
#>      cd     2          1 South Jail: published 3520, recomputed 3521
pub$lat <- c(44.39, 43.65)
obs2 <- data.frame(inst = c("North Jail", "Hill Jail"),
                   cd = c("3557", "3506"), lat = c(44.39 + 1e-12, 45.1))
rgnmapcmp(pub, obs2, "inst", cols = c("cd", "lat"))
#> rgnmapcmp: the maps disagree 
#>  column cells mismatched                      first
#>    rows     3          2 published only: South Jail
#>      cd     1          0                           
#>     lat     1          0                           
try(rgnmapcmp(pub, obs, "inst", cols = "lat"))
#> Error : rgnmapcmp: both frames need the compared columns; missing: lat.
